people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
translations.bsb: And Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.
translations.kjv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
translations.asv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah. These eight did Milcah bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
